title: The Top Shelf
can_do: 用“哪一层、旁边有什么、哪个盒子”把位置说清楚，让没去找过的人找到。

conversation_move.label: describe a place clearly enough for someone to act

trigger: Mom does not know where the trains are stored now and needs Child's directions.
setting: Child's bedroom doorway before tidy-up time.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Can you tell me where your trains go?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: They live on the top shelf, by the big bear.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The tall one behind my door, in the white box.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Is it the white box or the blue basket?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The white box. The blue basket holds my blocks.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Found them! You're a good guide.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The long train goes on top, so it stays straight.

replay_cards.title: Where the crayons live
replay_cards.setting: Mom tidies up and asks where the crayons belong now.
replay_cards.change: They moved from the old basket last week.
replay_cards.challenge: Child describes the new place as the second drawer, under the paper stack, clearly enough for Mom to put them away.

replay_cards.title: The watering can
replay_cards.setting: Grandma waters the plants but cannot find the watering can.
replay_cards.change: It changed spots after the balcony was cleaned.
replay_cards.challenge: Child describes its spot on the balcony shelf, behind the small pots, so Grandma finds it without help.

parent_support: 收纳换位置后，请孩子当“小向导”，只用嘴带大人找到东西。
大人故意问“是白盒还是蓝篮”，逼出更精确的位置描述。
找到后让孩子补一句“长的放上面”这类摆法细节，练习交代规则。
